title: NetSuRF M9.1 estimator-validation measurements
compatibility: Extends v3.2; existing v3.0, v3.1 and v3.2 readers and finalized bundles remain unchanged.
null_representation: empty CSV field for explicitly nullable values

empirical_bits.csv.sampling: Exact isolated-bit measurements on the recorded sampled population; inclusion_rule and sampling_probability identify selection.

estimator_predictions.csv.semantics: Raw estimator score and an optional signed loss-change prediction. Numerical bit jump is not a signed loss predictor.

ranking_metrics.csv.tie_semantics: Tie-aware expected recall is conditional on the measured candidate set and is not a whole-network claim.
ranking_metrics.csv.interval_semantics: Percentile intervals from deterministic within-recorded-stratum candidate resampling; sample-limited, not population-wide.

estimator_runtime.csv.warning: Shared per-example gradient time is repeated for dependent estimator rows and must not be summed.

replication_seed_semantics.estimator_seed_stride: Advances independently randomized estimator or ranking-mask seeds between replications.
replication_seed_semantics.hutchinson_seed_stride: Advances only Hutchinson probe seeds between replications.
replication_seed_semantics.fault_seed_stride: Advances only logical fault-schedule seeds between replications.
